messageSchema.direction: child (host bundle) -> parent (worker port), on the existing stdio[3] IPC channel

identityValidation.rule: a non-empty string of at most 200 characters containing no whitespace and no control character
identityValidation.rationale: DSH SessionId is an unconstrained branded string (its session schema is z.string().min(1)) and the worker host mints worker-<uuid>; a prefix rule would break on a resumed or forked session, and an any-string rule would admit control characters or path-shaped values into durable evidence

emissionPoint.location: host/dsh/lib/runner.js runWorker, immediately after agents.create() resolves
emissionPoint.identitySource: handle.agent.session.id (the CREATED handle), never the candidate string passed into agents.create

method: exercise the shipped producer over controlled send channels; assert the closed field set, the validation boundary, the no-IPC and send-failure containment, and the runner source ordering
expectedInvariant: the report carries exactly the created session identity, is emitted before any model turn, and can never fail a worker
transportCompatibilityChanges: none: the message reuses the existing stdio[3] IPC channel; no new transport, no new ACK protocol
remainingUncertainty: the real Host -> Parent route is measured separately in the Level C integration evidence
